We knew it was coming in January and now we have a specific date. Fox’s upcoming Baywatch reboot will premiere Wednesday, January 6 at 9 pm.
Fox has not released its midseason schedule yet, but in the last couple of years, The Masked Singe r has aired in the 8 pm timeslot and it is expected to remind in that slot in the upcoming season as a lead-in to Baywatch. This also marks the first time since 2024 that Fox has programmed scripted series on Wednesday nights ( Animal Control aired at 9 pm followed by Family Guy at 9:30 pm that year).
‘Baywatch’ Unveils Four New Teasers With Stephen Amell, Jessica Belkin, Livvy Dunne, Brooks Nader & More
Photos: The Cast Of The New ‘Baywatch’ TV Series & Who They Play
The new Baywatch finds wild-child legacy character Hobie Buchannon, played by Stephen Amell , serving as a Baywatch Captain, following in his legendary father Mitch’s footsteps. Hobie’s world is turned upside down when his daughter, Charlie Vale ( Jessica Belkin ), shows up on his doorstep, eager to carry on the Buchannon family legacy. Members of the new Baywatch team include Hassie Harrison as Nat, Shay Mitchell as Trina, Thaddeus LaGrone as Brad, Noah Beck as Luke, and Brooks Nader as Selene. Watch on Deadline
In recurring roles, Livvy Dunne will make her acting debut as Grace and David Chokachi will reprise his original series character of Cody Madison.
In the reboot, Fox promises that “fans can expect all the adrenaline-fueled rescues, tangled relationships, complicated chemistry and beachside heroics that defined the original — now with a new cast, contemporary trappings, tensions and challenges, and a renewed mission to save lives along Los Angeles’ beaches.
RELATED: 2026-27 Premiere Dates For New & Returning Series On Broadcast, Streaming & Cable Baywatch is co-produced by Fox Entertainment Studios and Fremantle with Matt Nix ( Burn Notice , The Gifted ) serving as showrunner and executive producer. McG, Michael Berk, Greg Bonann, Doug Schwartz, Dante Di Loreto and Mike Horowitz are executive producers. McG directed the series premiere.
